content:
Benjamin and Chance discuss the final Apple smart display rumors, suggesting a 'HomePad' will launch on October 13, though the small square screen size remains puzzling. Additionally, leaked photos of the iPad mini and HomePod mini show these long-awaited updates are also on the way; John Ternus apparently wants to make Apple more agile, and Chance shares his thoughts on the new Apple Watch Readiness feature.
